questions.q: Where had Paul left Titus?

options: Always liars, evil beasts, idle gluttons
Lovers of wine and of money

questions.q: Which group of deceivers does Paul especially single out?

questions.answer: by their deeds they deny him
wrong: in their hearts they doubt him
by their words they mock him

items: Greeting to Titus, his true child
To the pure, all things are pure
